data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to verify the integrity of the app and detect tampering at run time.
data.what_it_does: It verifies the integrity of the app at run time to detect tampering. It retrieves app checksum and signature values in SHA256 for both Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to verify app integrity and detect runtime tampering
You want to retrieve app checksums and signatures for security validation
avoid_when: You do not require security or app tampering checks
Target platforms other than Android and iOS are used
strengths: Provides runtime checksum and signature verification
Requires no complex configuration for Android or iOS
weaknesses: iOS checksum outputs differ between physical devices and emulators/non-Arm64 architectures
iOS signature changes when uploaded to the App Store due to Apple's code signing
data.setup_notes: No specific platform-based configurations needed for Android or iOS.
data.minimal_example:
String checksum = await AppIntegrityChecker.getchecksum() ?? "checksum retrieval failed";
String signature = await AppIntegrityChecker.getsignature() ?? "signature retrieval failed";
